def test_tlsv1_0_enabled(self):
    server_info = ServerConnectivityInfo(hostname='www.google.com')
    server_info.test_connectivity_to_server()

    plugin = OpenSslCipherSuitesPlugin()
    plugin_result = plugin.process_task(server_info, 'tlsv1')

    # More specific check for preferred cipher
    self.assertIsNotNone(plugin_result.preferred_cipher)
    self.assertGreater(len(plugin_result.accepted_cipher_list), 0)
    self.assertGreater(len(plugin_result.rejected_cipher_list), 0)
    self.assertEqual(len(plugin_result.errored_cipher_list), 0)

    self.assertTrue(plugin_result.as_text())
    self.assertTrue(plugin_result.as_xml())
